<plan>We start by moving west to get adjacent to the tree (2 steps away). Once adjacent and facing the tree, we will use Do to collect wood (saplings already in inventory but collecting more ensures we have enough for the “Collect Wood” achievement and for building a table). After obtaining wood, we will Place Table on the adjacent grass tile. Using the table and our wood, we will Make Wood Pickaxe and Make Wood Sword, completing the early achievements (Collect Wood, Place Table, Make Wood Pickaxe, Make Wood Sword). 

Next, we will use the wood pickaxe to mine stone from the nearby stone (if present) or from the tree stump area, then Place Stone and collect stone (achievement Collect Stone, Place Stone). With stone and wood we will Make Stone Pickaxe and Stone Sword (achievements 14,15). 

We will then locate a coal source (often found near stone) and use the stone pickaxe to collect coal (Collect Coal). After that, we will find iron ore (usually near deeper stone) and collect iron (Collect Iron). With wood, stone, coal, and iron we will craft an Iron Pickaxe and Iron Sword (achievements 20,21). 

We will also Place Furnace near the table to smelt iron if needed (Place Furnace). Then we will collect diamond using the iron pickaxe (Collect Diamond). 

Meanwhile, we will move to the cow (south‑east) and use Do to Eat Cow (Eat Cow) and to collect any meat. We will also Place Plant on a grass tile (Place Plant) and then Eat Plant (Eat Plant). 

We will locate zombies and skeletons, equip appropriate swords, and Defeat Zombie and Defeat Skeleton (achievements 9,13). Finally, after sleeping once to reset energy (Sleep) we will Wake Up (achievement 16). This sequence covers all 22 achievements.>
